name: Care Manager
summary: Keeps track of someone's medicines and doctor visits for the whole family: nudges at dose time, raises the alarm when a dose is missed, and warns before pills run out.
handles: A nudge at each dose time; one tap or "taken" confirms it
If a dose isn't confirmed in time, one clear alert to the family saying who missed what
Counts pills down with every dose and warns before they run out, with a tap to call the pharmacy
Appointment reminders the evening before and 2 hours ahead
A 21:00 summary of the day, and the week's adherence on Sundays
setup: Type the person's name and their medicines, one per line: name | times | pills left.
Share the agent with them and the family (Settings → Shared with).
They tap Run → "Took my due medicines" (or reply "taken") after each dose.

fields.label: Who you care for
fields.help: Their name as the family says it.

fields.label: Medicines
fields.help: One per line: name | times | pills left (optional), e.g. "Metformin 500mg | 08:00, 20:00 | 60".

fields.label: Their phone
fields.help: Optional: a one-tap call on missed-dose alerts.

fields.label: Pharmacy phone
fields.help: Optional: a one-tap call on refill alerts.

fields.label: Doctor's phone
fields.help: Optional: a one-tap call on appointment reminders.

fields.label: Refill warning (days)
fields.help: Warn when this many days of pills are left.

fields.label: Missed-dose alert after (min)
fields.help: Minutes without a confirmation before the family is alerted.

after: Share it with the person and the family under Settings → Shared with. At each dose time they tap Run → "Took my due medicines", or reply "taken" here.
